stories.title: Bitcoin's on-chain demand turns negative as price stalls near $77,000
stories.summary: Bitcoin is trading near $77,000. Cointelegraph reports that a measure of apparent demand for Bitcoin has turned negative. CryptoSlate says $47 billion of profitable supply must clear before Bitcoin can break out above $80,000.
stories.whyItMatters: Weak demand signals can slow or stall a price rally, so this matters to anyone gauging near-term momentum.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin holds above $77,000
Any rebound in the apparent-demand metric
Progress toward the $80,000 level
questions: How reliable is the 'apparent demand' metric cited here?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s next $80,000 breakout has $47 billion more profitable supply to absorb
Bitcoin’s apparent demand turns negative as price struggles with $77K

stories.title: Bitcoin whipsaws near $77,000, and ETF investors do the same
stories.summary: Bitcoin has swung back and forth around $77,000, per CryptoSlate. Spot Bitcoin ETF investors have shown a similar pattern, moving money in and then back out.
stories.whyItMatters: It ties spot-market volatility to ETF fund flows, a key gauge of institutional sentiment.
whatToWatch: Daily ETF net flow figures
Whether Bitcoin finds a stable price range
questions: Are ETF investors leading these price swings, or following them?

stories.title: Coldcard hacker moves stolen Bitcoin into Ether via THORChain
stories.summary: An attacker who stole Bitcoin from Coldcard hardware wallets has swapped the funds for Ether. Per Cointelegraph, the swap ran through the cross-chain protocol THORChain.
stories.whyItMatters: Hardware-wallet compromises are rare and serious, and the use of THORChain shows how hard stolen crypto is to trace and freeze.
whatToWatch: Whether Coldcard confirms the scope of the breach
Any recovery or freeze effort by exchanges
Further wallet security advisories
questions: How were the Coldcard wallets compromised?
How much Bitcoin was stolen in total?

stories.title: Dubai regulator VARA and Securitize sign tokenization MoU
stories.summary: Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) and tokenization firm Securitize have signed a memorandum of understanding. The deal covers cooperation on tokenization innovation, per Cointelegraph.
stories.whyItMatters: Deals like this between regulators and industry shape how tokenized assets get approved and adopted in major financial hubs.
whatToWatch: Details of specific tokenization projects that follow the MoU
Whether other regulators sign similar deals
questions: What concrete rules or products will result from this MoU?

stories.title: Ether and XRP ETF inflow streaks end as Bitcoin funds rebound
stories.summary: Spot Ether and XRP ETFs have seen their inflow streaks stop, according to Cointelegraph. At the same time, Bitcoin ETFs posted a rebound in inflows.
stories.whyItMatters: Shifting ETF flows across assets are a leading indicator of changing institutional preference that many traders watch closely.
whatToWatch: Next daily or weekly ETF flow reports
Whether Bitcoin fund inflows hold up
Whether Ether and XRP flows turn negative or stabilize
questions: What drove the rotation back toward Bitcoin funds?

stories.title: Hyperscale Data exits Michigan Bitcoin mining as holdings drop 79%
stories.summary: Hyperscale Data has ended its Bitcoin mining operations in Michigan. Per Cointelegraph, the company's Bitcoin holdings have fallen 79%.
stories.whyItMatters: A steep holdings decline and a site shutdown point to financial strain among smaller miners as the industry consolidates.
whatToWatch: Hyperscale Data's next earnings or holdings update
Whether other miners scale back operations too
questions: Why did holdings fall 79% - sales, impairment, or something else?
What happens to the Michigan facility now?

stories.summary: Standard Chartered has begun offering spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the United Arab Emirates, per Cointelegraph.
stories.whyItMatters: A major global bank offering spot crypto trading signals growing institutional acceptance of digital assets in the region.
whatToWatch: Client uptake and trading volumes
Whether Standard Chartered expands to more markets or assets

stories.summary: SoFi has struck a deal connecting its banking network and stablecoin to the crypto exchange Kraken, according to Decrypt.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows fintech and crypto exchanges building deeper infrastructure ties, easing the path between fiat and crypto for users.
whatToWatch: Rollout timeline for the SoFi-Kraken integration
How the stablecoin link works in practice for users
questions: What specific services does this integration enable?

stories.title: Robinhood's tokenized stocks draw memecoin traders testing the limits
stories.summary: Robinhood put stock trading on a permissionless blockchain. Per CryptoSlate, memecoin traders are now using that setup to stress-test what it allows.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized equities on an open blockchain raise questions about how regulated securities behave once exposed to permissionless, speculative trading.
whatToWatch: Any response or restrictions from Robinhood
Regulatory reaction to tokenized stock trading
Further examples of unconventional trading activity on the platform
questions: Does this activity conflict with Robinhood's terms or securities rules?
How exposed are ordinary investors to this behavior?

stories.title: Japan's Remixpoint sells Ethereum and XRP to go Bitcoin-only
stories.summary: Japanese company Remixpoint has sold its Ethereum and XRP holdings. Per Decrypt, it is shifting its corporate treasury to hold Bitcoin only.
stories.whyItMatters: It is another case of a public company narrowing its crypto treasury to Bitcoin alone, a trend worth tracking among corporate holders.
whatToWatch: Remixpoint's future Bitcoin purchases
Whether other companies adopt a Bitcoin-only treasury approach
questions: What drove the decision to drop Ethereum and XRP specifically?

sources.title: Japan’s Remixpoint Dumps Ethereum, XRP in Shift to Bitcoin-Only Treasury

stories.title: Bitcoin's path past $80,000 hinges on an 880,000 BTC supply cluster
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that a large concentration of about 880,000 BTC has capped Bitcoin's past rallies. The analysis says this supply cluster must clear before Bitcoin can sustainably break above $80,000.
stories.whyItMatters: Large holder clusters near key price levels can act as resistance, so the claim shapes near-term price expectations if it holds up.
whatToWatch: Whether the cited BTC cluster starts moving or selling
Price action if Bitcoin approaches $80,000 again
questions: How was the 880,000 BTC figure calculated, and by whom?
Has this level actually capped rallies before, or is this a new claim?

sources.title: Bitcoin cannot break out past $80,000 until it devours an 880k BTC roadblock that choked every rally

stories.title: Recovery specialists crack $1 billion crypto wallet, find just $10 inside
stories.summary: A team of recovery specialists cracked into a crypto wallet once believed to hold $1 billion in assets. Per Cointelegraph, they found only about $10 inside.
stories.whyItMatters: It is a reminder that rumored high-value wallets often don't match reality, which should temper hype around 'lost fortune' recovery stories.
whatToWatch: Whether the wallet's original owner or history gets disclosed
Other high-profile wallet recovery attempts
questions: Why was the wallet believed to hold $1 billion?
What happened to the funds if they were once there?

sources.title: Recovery specialists crack $1B crypto wallet... but find just $10
